n: Daily rewards: one each day in a 7-day cycle, each with its own 3D model. Spark Cell, Battery, Pet Egg, Fragment Crystal, Double Day (all energy ×2 for 24 hours), Hourglass and Golden Crown (×3 for 6 hours plus a rare egg). Missing a day never resets anything
Permanent upgrades: 12 upgrades bought with energy that no prestige ever resets, not even Ultra. Find them at the front of the Upgrades tab and in a gold bar on the Engine screen

Automation: each auto-prestige can fire on gain, on a timer (every N minutes) or when the gain is a multiple of what you have. A new Fragment perk, Rebirth Autopilot, unlocks Auto-Rebirth early so you can grind AFK. On PC, Automation has its own tab
On PC: Bosses and Pets have their own tabs, and the game is a bit wider (700 px, still a centred column)
Graphics settings: 30 or 60 fps (30 draws half as often, animations keep their speed) and a pixel-size slider with a live preview of the sky
A busier sky in the same style: far galaxies, star clusters, a ringed planet, drifting asteroids, a satellite and the odd comet, coloured to match each world
30 new very hard achievements, up to 'Ten Cells, Complete' for unlocking every other one
Story: the later 'spend time with the Engine' missions ask for much less (chapter 10 was 3.5 hours, now 2), and the 'play on different days' missions are gone
The upgrade tree view goes back to the middle after a prestige
Windows app: a Collapse button (or C) hides the game and leaves a small animated atom in the corner of the screen. The game keeps earning without drawing anything; click the atom to come back
